name: ResponderDetailPanel
intent: Floating profile for one safety responder — identity, alert tally, acknowledgement mix and coverage.
when: A responder selected on a map needs their profile without leaving the map
Responder performance is read alongside the observations they answer

chooseOver.because: ObservationDetailPanel is a ticket with a lifecycle and a comment thread. ResponderDetailPanel is a person: a read-only profile with tallies and coverage, no actions to take on it.

commonMistakes: Giving responders a different panel width from the other floating panels — the frame jumps when switching between a violation, a camera and a responder. All default to 340.
stubPlan: dataContract: stub — author input fields, slots, rowIdentity
configSchema: stub — enumerate config props from source

lineage.confidence: unset — open flow exercised end-to-end in the browser; no held-out eval yet
notes: Record shape mirrors the Safety Manager responder list so a responder reads the same from map or list.

usage: Use ResponderDetailPanel to structure and organize content within your interface. This component helps create visual hierarchy and consistent spacing throughout your application.

ResponderDetailPanel works well for arranging related content, creating responsive layouts, and maintaining visual consistency. Use it to group related elements and establish clear content boundaries.

props.name: nearby
props.description: Violations inside their coverage radius that are not theirs — the ones they are close enough to pick up.

props.name: coverageMeters
props.description: Radius the `nearby` list was gathered from, for the section heading.

props.name: width
props.description: Panel width in px. Default `340`, matching the other floating panels.
